title: JSON→DB writer 切换: state.json + ticket.json + audit log
description:
现状: state.json / jira/tickets/*/ticket.json / audit log 仍写 file。目标: 双写 → DB-only。
1. Rust runtime 写 tickets/instances 表 (schema 已建, INSERT 只 tickets 有)
2. session_start.sh state.json 增写 SQLite instances 表 (保留 file 兼容)
3. audit log JSONL → trace_spans 表
acceptance: INSERT/UPDATE 覆盖 instances / trace_spans / dag_runs / dag_node_states 4 表
session_start 双写 (file + DB) 通过 smoke test
